affirmations.title:
Do you recognize yourself
in this situation?
items: I've already tried to cut down or quit smoking, but I couldn't stick with it long-term.
Sometimes I light a cigarette automatically, without even really wanting to.
I don't really know how to cut down gradually without falling back into my old habits.

deculpabilisation.title:
Rest assured, it's not
just a lack of willpower
deculpabilisation.subtitle: Addiction is built on habits, triggers and automatic behaviors. By understanding them, you can gradually take back control.
deculpabilisation.note: Illustration of the principle — your journey will be unique.

solution.title:
Move at your own pace,
with a tailored plan
solution.subtitle: Every smoker is different. Stopklop builds a personalized plan based on your consumption, your habits and your goal: gradually reducing or quitting completely.

items.title: Every cigarette becomes a choice
items.text: Easily log your cigarettes and discover the ones you smoke out of craving… and the ones that are just a habit.

items.title: Identify what triggers your urge to smoke
items.text: Stopklop analyzes the moments, situations and emotions linked to your smoking to help you better anticipate cravings.

items.title: Reduce at your own pace, without unnecessary pressure
items.text: Your goal evolves according to your consumption and your progress. Every step stays realistic, measurable and suited to your daily life.

items.title: Every cigarette avoided really counts
items.text: Watch in real time the cigarettes avoided, the money saved and the time gradually regained.
